path_base: All asset and prompt paths are relative to akari-v4.0/.

new_scene.wardrobe: Specify separately for each scene; B06 clothing is a comparison outfit.

existing_image_edit.note: The edit target owns composition, camera and pose unless the user requests changing them.

usage_rules: Open the relevant native images before generation and explicitly assign each reference role.
V11 supplies face, grey eyes, black bob, single silver pin, light lines and shallow pastel cel rendering.
B06 supplies the selected body balance and soft arm/leg volume. Its small face does not replace V11.
Follow the visible B06 proportions, not the approximate 7.25-head target in its generation transcript.
B06 white T-shirt, navy shorts, white socks and sneakers are comparison clothing, not a permanent uniform.
Keep outfit, scene, pose, camera and expression free according to each request.
Generate each new scene independently from V11/B06; previous scenes are examples, not replacement authorities.
Do not append numeric-age or adult-woman tags; the user explicitly excluded them from prompts.
Previous-version face/body/clothing references are historical and do not override V11/B06 for v4.0.
Where socks are visible, use soft opaque cloth and sparse shallow wrinkles; shoes may cover the toes.
